summary: Iteration 12: retest of the Razorpay capture fix, backend and frontend, using the preview URL. The CRITICAL issue from iteration 11 is FIXED. (1) A real test-mode payment through the hosted checkout (Netbanking > SBI > Success) on a fresh throwaway user and order (order_TxC6mXT5wKiE6a, silver): Razorpay shows the order 'paid' with amount_paid 29900 and the payment 'captured'. The callback page shows 'Payment successful! Your plan is active.', GET /api/plans current shows silver valid for 365 days, and razorpay_payment_id (pay_TxCA5GmlOARpdY) is stored, not NULL. (2) The fallback path also works. I created an order straight through the Razorpay API with no capture setting and added a matching DB row. After the real SBI payment, sync_order captured the authorized payment: the order became paid, the DB row PAID with the payment id stored, and the plan upgraded to gold. (3) For an old provider='cashfree' order (a TEST row inserted for the throwaway user), GET /api/payments/{id} returns 200 with status EXPIRED and saves EXPIRED in the DB, with no 502. Checkout returns 404 for that order and for 3 real old Cashfree orders (checked read-only). (4) AMOUNT_MISMATCH: I faked the Razorpay order fetch (fetch_rzp_order monkeypatched) to return paid with the wrong amount. AMOUNT_MISMATCH was saved; a second sync_order returned it without calling Razorpay again, and no plan was activated. (5) Idempotency: a repeat valid-signature callback plus status polls did not change expires_at, on 3 paid orders. The pytest idempotency test passes with PAID_ORDER_ID/PAID_TOKEN. (6) test_payments.py: 24 passed, 1 skipped (the idempotency test, which needs a real paid order and passed when run separately). The webhook returns 503 because its secret is not set, as expected. FRONTEND at 375x667: the /plans subtitle 'Secure payment by Razorpay' is fully visible (scrollWidth equals clientWidth, 255px). Full UI flow tested: log in, tap plan-buy-gold, checkout opens in a new tab, plans-checking appears, pay with SBI Success. The app poll then shows the Active Business Pro banner valid till 07 Nov 2027, Silver/Gold 'Included in your plan' and Platinum 'Upgrade · Pay ₹2499'. The poll is 100 x 3 s, about 5 minutes. Buttons are 48px tall. No deprecated Expo packages in plans.tsx.

minor.issue: 17 old provider='cashfree' rows stay ACTIVE until each one is polled. Checkout returns 404 and status lazily returns EXPIRED, so this is harmless, but a one-time UPDATE to EXPIRED would clean up the data.
Status FAILED is never set. A failed or abandoned payment stays ACTIVE, and the app polls for the full ~5 minutes before showing 'Payment not completed'.

action_items: Optional: mark the legacy Cashfree ACTIVE rows as EXPIRED with a one-time migration.
Optional: on /plans, add a 'Check again' button after the poll times out, and stop polling early when the payment failed.
Before going live: set RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET and register the order.paid and payment.captured webhooks.
critical_code_review_comments: The capture fix is correct. The order payload has payment.capture='automatic' with capture_options. As a fallback, capture_authorized() captures an authorized payment of matching amount and treats an 'already been captured' response as success (safe if the callback and a poll run at the same time).
Activation is claimed atomically with UPDATE ... WHERE status <> 'PAID' RETURNING, so activate() runs only once. Verified.

Upgrade policy unchanged: silver to gold sets expiry to the current expiry plus 365 days and gives the higher tier at once (observed 2028-11-06 after silver 2027-11-07). Confirm this is the business rule you want.

success_rate.backend: 100% (24/24 plus idempotency; real payment, fallback capture, Cashfree expiry and AMOUNT_MISMATCH all verified)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (real end-to-end purchase activated the plan through polling; subtitle not truncated)

seed_data_creation: Throwaway users test_rzp12_d7665f and test_rzpui12_11267 were created, made 3 real test payments (299 and 999 x2) and were deleted with DELETE /api/users/me. Their payments, including the TEST_cf_* and TEST_mm_* rows, were removed by cascade (verified: 0 rows left). The 3 real old Cashfree orders were only read through the checkout GET (404, no state change). admin and inbox_user were not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use helper /app/backend/tests/iter12_rzp_helper.py (new / inspect / status / dbcheck / cf_expired / mismatch / fallback_order / delete) with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exported; Razorpay keys are in the shell env. Checkout automation: select the frame whose url startswith 'https://api.razorpay.com/v1/checkout/public' (other frames also contain that string). The mobile step is sometimes skipped; 9876543210 is rejected as invalid, use 9123456789. Then Netbanking > SBI > Continue (the frame detaches), then click 'Success' on the mocksharp page.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 11 root cause (no capture) is fixed by order-level auto-capture plus a server-side capture fallback. Both were verified with real Razorpay test-mode payments.
